name: 해방된 할파스
user_authorization: Production image tools allowed. No images, previews, links, binary or base64 in main chat. One materially corrected source attempt only.
corrective_reason: Selected NW idle is front-left; v02 correction hid chest but remained N/NE with boot toes toward screen-right. Reconstruct new consistent NW upper-left bearing midway between verified N and W, including helmet, back/hips and both boot axes; preserve anatomy/right-hand weapon.
prompt:
Edit the established Halpas unique-boss sprite model into ONE SIX-FRAME NORTHWEST IDLE animation atlas. Image 1 is the existing NORTH/BACK idle, image 2 the correct WEST/LEFT lateral idle. Construct the actual intermediate camera view between these TWO views: 45 degrees between facing straight AWAY/UP and straight LEFT. Image 3 is original identity/material only. This is a new NW camera angle of the SAME character, never a horizontal flip, redesign or repeated wrong NORTH/NORTHEAST pose.

MANDATORY GEOMETRY: Character forward direction is screen UPPER-LEFT (-x,-y) in ALL SIX frames. We look at the BACK and the anatomical RIGHT side. The helmet nose/brow tip points diagonally UPPER-LEFT; back of helmet, right shoulder rear face and long back/spine armor are dominant. Front skull breastplate and frontal face are HIDDEN on the far upper-left side. Hips, knees and both boot axes agree with helmet: boot TOES project UPPER-LEFT from their heels, absolutely never lower-right/right/down-left. The viewer sees heel/rear ankle and right outer boot surfaces. Both feet remain in the same modest stationary NW guard stance. Do not produce the unrotated straight NORTH model from reference1. Do not reproduce the WEST side angle from reference2. Visibly reconstruct a coherent rear-left three-quarter view halfway between them, fixed throughout cycle.

ANATOMY/IDENTITY: Exact black-and-gold plate armor, narrow gold-edged articulated spine/back plates, horned gold helmet, two established purple crystalline feather-fan wings and their two gold shoulder roots, burgundy tattered cape, two complete arms and legs, single short broad purple crystalline blade. Existing anatomical RIGHT hand holds the one blade. In rear-NW view the right weapon shoulder/upper arm is on the near/viewer-right side of the back, clearly connected through elbow to hand, naturally lowered outward slightly to screen-right beside thigh; do not swap to left hand or add a hand. Cape remains on same anatomical LEFT side as reference1. Rotate asymmetrical equipment with the body, never mirror. BOTH original solid purple crystalline wing fans remain recognizable, farther wing properly foreshortened/partly occluded, nearer right wing in front of it; no new wing pair or membrane. Same armor proportions and elevated orthographic/isometric game camera as N/W references. Material colors/pixel detail remain excellent.

IDLE ANIMATION, six independently articulated complete poses in reading order: 0 quiet neutral NW guard, 1 small breathing lift at shoulders/right elbow with wings beginning to flex, 2 inhalation peak, feather fans slightly opening and delayed cape fold rising, 3 exhale with wings lowering and slight knee/hip weight release, 4 low breath with cape follow-through and local wing-finger relaxation, 5 smooth recovery toward frame0. Calm living-boss breathing, not walking, no foot swapping, attack, camera rotation, model morph or body translation. Same boot support, anatomical hand, compass, body scale and perspective in all six. Visible local articulated breathing changes, not six duplicate stills.

LAYOUT: transparent PNG exactly 1024x1536, TWO512px COLUMNS by THREE512px ROWS. Exactly SIX characters, one per cell. Full silhouette including every horn/wing/cape/boot/blade tip fits central320x320 area of each cell; body crown-to-foot only about280-310pixels, never zoom full figure to cell edge. At least90px fully empty transparent margin around each full silhouette. Every figure detached, complete and uncropped, generous transparent gutters. Uniform body scale. Detailed crisp opaque sprites, only1-2pixel antialiasing edge. Background and gaps alpha0. Purple light/color INSIDE solid wing/blade only: no outer glow, bloom, haze, shadows, ground, floor, particles, trails, text, labels, grids or frames. Highest priority is TRUE REAR-LEFT/NORTHWEST bearing of helmet+torso+hips+boot toes across all6, with original right-hand blade and original two-wing identity.
